correctness.rationale: The formulas agree with the earlier independently stated five-regime theorem and survive direct algebraic reconstruction. The r=2 expansion matches the exact asymmetric-Laplace check. The bundled numerical code was inspected; independently redoing the parameter conversions reproduces the Wishart corollaries.
